## **The problem**

The SME's in Colombia have difficulties recording the moving money from a lot of different payment methods with different delays for each method.

## **Why this one?**

We identified that is a real problem that even known people have in real small business . With that in mind, knowing that a lot of people in Colombia live working in SME's and in most of the cases are self-owned informal business, we think that simplifying the process of taking an accountable register in a faster and accessible way is valuable in the colombian context and in some other similar in latin america.

## **Discarted proposals and decision making**

We haven't discussed their proposals, at least not in a serious way. After a brainstorm this looked like the only problem that have real impact in our reality. So the moment after André came up with the idea the acceptance was unanimous.
